filemanage:rename-files.title: Rename Files
filemanage:rename-files.intro: Preview rename results across the workspace before running text transforms, delimiter trims, or numbering rules.

filemanage:change-file-extension.title: Change File Extension
filemanage:change-file-extension.intro: Convert supported images to another extension using the configured old and new suffix rules.

filemanage:extract-zip.title: Extract ZIP
filemanage:extract-zip.intro: Find ZIP archives in the workspace and unpack each one into a folder beside the archive.

filemanage:images-to-pdf.title: Images To PDF
filemanage:images-to-pdf.intro: Use the folder-based image to PDF workflow, with image fitting and cleanup options from settings.

filemanage:pdf-to-images.title: PDF To Images
filemanage:pdf-to-images.intro: Export PDF pages into image folders from the current FileManage workspace.

filemanage:webp-to-mp4.title: WebP To MP4
filemanage:webp-to-mp4.intro: Convert static and animated WebP files into MP4 while mirroring the workspace folder structure into the output root.

filemanage_setting:workspace.title: Workspace Settings
filemanage_setting:workspace.intro: Set the root folder that every FileManage tool will scan and update.

filemanage_setting:rename.title: Rename Settings
filemanage_setting:rename.intro: Configure the Rename Files tool to transform text, trim names by delimiter, or apply numbering rules across matching filenames.

filemanage_setting:extension.title: Extension Settings
filemanage_setting:extension.intro: Choose which image suffix to convert from and what new extension should be written.

filemanage_setting:zip.title: ZIP Settings
filemanage_setting:zip.intro: Control recursive ZIP extraction and whether the original archives should be deleted after success.

filemanage_setting:images-to-pdf.title: Images To PDF Settings
filemanage_setting:images-to-pdf.intro: Configure the folder-based image-to-PDF workflow imported from the example scripts.

filemanage_setting:pdf-to-images.title: PDF To Images Settings
filemanage_setting:pdf-to-images.intro: Choose how PDFs are exported back into image pages and whether source PDFs are kept.

filemanage_setting:webp-to-mp4.title: WebP To MP4 Settings
filemanage_setting:webp-to-mp4.intro: Choose where converted MP4 files should be written and how ffmpeg should encode each WebP file.
